newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Cumberland County, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Cumberland County, N.J..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial Officer of the County at the County Administration Building, 790 East Commerce Street, Bridgeton, N.J. on

until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the County dated June 15, 1997 and due on February 15 in the principal amount of $382,000 in 1998, $150,000 in 1999 and $300,000 in each of the years 2000 to 2007, inclusive.

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to their stated maturities. The County will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland L.L.C., Newark, N.J.

The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% (ascending rates and only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on February 15 and August 15 in each year until maturity, commencing February 15, 1998. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.
The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting Gerald C. Seneski, the Chief Financial Officer at the above address, or at (609) 453-2136.
